name: KBLI tax hints
authority: Badan Pusat Statistik publishes KBLI. DJP does not publish one KBLI-to-rate table.

verification.notes: No KBLI code is asserted in this starter. An empty list is intentional.

notes: KBLI classifies business activity. It is not a PPN rate and not a KAP. Add an entry only when a regulation attaches a tax treatment to that activity, and put the regulation in legal_citations. Set verification to verified_starter only after that citation exists. Do not copy a code from memory. A future entry looks like { code, name, maps_to.treatment_id, maps_to.semantic_code, legal_citations } and must use a real BPS code.
